claim: Lu and Rowlett prove one can hear the shape of parallelograms, acute trapezoids, and the regular n-gon among convex domains.
stance_target: scope of exact-determinacy inverse spectral shape results
quoted_support: These are then used to prove that one can hear the shape of: parallelograms, acute trapezoids, and the regular n-gon.

claim: The regular n-gon is uniquely determined among all convex n-gons by a finite number of Laplace eigenvalues, a finite-coefficient determinacy result rather than a stability/conditioning estimate.
stance_target: finite-coefficient determinacy results in this literature state a sufficient count for exact recovery but do not quantify robustness to eigenvalue error
scope_conditions: regular n-gon vs. all convex n-gons; Dirichlet Laplacian
quoted_support: we show that one can realistically hear the shape of the regular n-gon amongst all convex n-gons because it is uniquely determined by a finite number of eigenvalues; the sound of symmetry can really be heard!

claim: The published version of Lu-Rowlett's paper is The American Mathematical Monthly 122(9):815-835 (2015), DOI 10.4169/amer.math.monthly.122.9.815, linked directly from the arXiv record as the Related DOI.
stance_target: bibliographic record for a competing/adjacent finite-invariant determinacy result
